title: Awesome Digital Nepal — Category Schema
description: Schema for a single category file in src/data/categories/. Each file represents one category and contains an array of resources.

id.description: URL-safe slug used in routing, e.g. 'fintech-payments'.

tagline.description: Short 1-line tagline shown on category cards.

description.description: Longer prose description shown at the top of the category page.

icon.description: Single emoji or short symbol used as a visual mark.

description.description: 1–3 sentences. Be factual, no marketing copy.

status.description: official = first-party / government; community = third-party but legitimately published; unofficial = scraper/reverse-engineered; deprecated = no longer maintained.

maintenance.description: active = recent commits/updates; stale = >1yr no activity; archived = explicitly archived.

starred.description: Mark as essential / first-class citizen for this category.

note.description: Optional caveat (e.g., legal, deprecation, usage warning).
